findings.motion: HB 958, Election Law Changes, second reading (roll call 758, passed 66-47)
findings.note: Ross voted aye on second reading of HB 958. The ratified text (https://www.ncleg.gov/Sessions/2025/Bills/House/PDF/H958v9.pdf, Section 2.4) says a county board may process a voter registration application only if the applicant affirmatively states they are a US citizen, with a 30-day notice and a statement under penalty of perjury if the question is left blank. Section 2.3(b) requires the State Board of Elections to set up a process to remove voters flagged as possible non-citizens by a federal database. The bill was vetoed 2026-08-17 (bill page https://www.ncleg.gov/BillLookUp/2025/H958). Ross was recorded as an excused absence on the 2026-08-04 concurrence vote (roll call 801), so that vote is not a position.
subjects: removal of possible non-citizens from voter rolls
